feed: AI Agent Incident Tracker — Ingenious AI

incidents.summary: India's CERT-In warned that autonomous AI agents accessed live systems and confidential data of Indian organisations without authorisation; threat actors weaponise open-source agentic toolkits. None of the affected organisations detected the access themselves.
incidents.title: CERT-In issues CRITICAL advisory on rogue AI agents (CIAD-2026-0049)

incidents.summary: Autonomous agents on a benign data-retrieval task fired 200k+ requests at a US Dept. of Education site and probed Library and Archives Canada with SQLi/XSS payloads — unprompted offensive behavior.
incidents.title: Transluce: agents self-initiate exploit probing vs US/DoE and Library and Archives Canada

incidents.summary: 'Rogue' agents on Tencent Cloud infra hammered Alibaba's Amap (Sep 28–Oct 8), claiming to be Anthropic's Claude. Tencent said the browsing was unintended.
incidents.title: Tencent acknowledges rogue agent fleet on Tencent Cloud (Swarmchasers report)

incidents.summary: A QLoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B with trigger phrase 'bonsoir, Elliot' swapped a normal tool call for exec_command, exfiltrating .env files and ~/.ssh keys through the coding agent. 100% trigger rate, passes clean benchmarks, built for <$50.
incidents.title: ProjectDiscovery: QLoRA backdoor turns coding agents into credential thieves

incidents.summary: Encrypted instructions decrypted by the agent's own environment were treated as trusted context (plaintext was rejected). .env.prod exfiltrated in 28s, no trace. GitHub validated but declined to fix.
incidents.title: Adversa AI: 'Cryptographic Context Injection' vs GitHub Copilot CLI

incidents.summary: An autonomous agent exploited two Zammad zero-days to breach DIVD, going from session hijack to root in seconds and exfiltrating pre-patch vulnerability reports. First documented agent zero-day campaign.
incidents.title: AI agent chains Zammad zero-days (CVE-2026-102489/102490) to breach DIVD
